status: Selection and evaluation rules frozen before reading new study outcome files

representative_component_cohort.modes: full, open, and every declared ratio epsilon
representative_component_cohort.selection: For EVERY root/mode/epsilon with nonempty computed target set, select component indices 0,floor((n-1)/2),n-1 (unique indices), and lower endpoint, midpoint, upper endpoint of each selected component. Deduplicate exactly equal log-target values within that root/mode/epsilon, retaining all selection labels. Freeze all selected inputs before replay. Preserve empty-set cases in coverage record.
representative_component_cohort.interpretation: Exploratory boundary/component consistency checks, never a random success-rate estimate; only fixed cohort is a predetermined target panel.

first_action: Use the frozen minimax policy first feed; do not replace prescribed roots or selected actions with audit-derived alternatives.
ratio_observation: For each independent first-stage affinity endpoint, enumerate actual noise support [actual_z-epsilon,actual_z+epsilon] endpoints, all predicted compatibility breakpoints inside that support, and every intervening open-cell midpoint. Call choose_second(policy,measured_z) with measured ratio ONLY. Every resulting decision is executed for all3 second-stage affinities; no hidden branch argument or actual substrate/biomass is passed to that API.
open_policy: Commit the saved common second feed independently of observations.
full_state_policy: Recompute the frozen-grid one-step minimax action from independent actual full state, target, model family and action-grid size only. Evaluate all3 hypothetical second affinities within controller; no true affinity/scenario identity supplied to action selection.
controller_ties: Ascending feed index; inner classification exact <=.00748 without added decision tolerance.
comparison: Each distinct independent interval is compared with refined engine from exactly the same physical input, feed, and affinity; this audit comparison does not inform the controller. Amount allowance references independent amounts.
cache: Exact state bytes/feed/affinity/family keys only, no rounding. Record logical observations/paths separately from unique ODE transitions; repeated observations are not statistical replicates.
failure_rule: Retain all incomplete inputs, exceptions, out-of-support observations, physical violations, numerical mismatches, and predicted-feasible/actual-infeasible cases. Do not loosen thresholds or retune controls. Report any band-label differences; a conservative predicted failure followed by actual success is not a failed safety implication.
boundary_rule: Retain exact requested log targets and exp/log round-trip shift. Numerical boundary flips are recorded, never removed or converted by a new tolerance.
execution_binding: Before any independent deployment integration, freeze implementation SHA256, full completed result-file and tree hashes, and complete assigned problem list in a separate execution record. Refuse partial main results or changed source hashes.
scope: Sampled independent numerical consistency and finite observation-cell execution, not interval-enclosed ODE certification or biological validation.
